description: This file defines the EmailSubscriptionModel class, which models the data for email subscriptions within the OrangeHRM system's admin API. It uses traits and annotations for serialization, and constructs a model for representing email notification subscriptions, including subscriber details.

classes.name: EmailSubscriptionModel
classes.description: A model class representing email subscription data, including subscriber info and enabled status, used for API responses in the OrangeHRM admin module.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the model with an EmailNotification entity and configures serialization filters and attribute mappings.
